title: SEC6/decision: KITHD_BASE_URL cascading fallback pattern in session_handler
description: crates/kithd/src/lib.rs session_handler (lines 59-66) reads base_url using a three-step cascade: (1) KITHD_BASE_URL, (2) deprecated KITH_BASE_URL with eprintln warning, (3) DEFAULT_BASE_URL constant. This is read at request time rather than in Config::from_env() because the base_url is used only in session responses and the deprecation warning should fire on actual use, not just on startup. The pattern matches the precedent established in config.rs for KITH_OWNER_ID, KITH_BIND_ADDR, and KITH_DB_PATH — all follow the same new-var → deprecated-var-with-warning → hardcoded-default cascade. Trade-off accepted: reading env vars per-request is slightly wasteful but the session endpoint is not on a hot path.
